name: Failed Module initialization exposes no partial state and does not retry

input.fixture_ref: Fail a dependency Module after staging state, access it and its dependent twice, then perform an explicit reload.

applicability.reason: Requires persistent Module load-attempt state. Package sources now accept declarations, but a failed initialization records no retained failed state and no explicit reload entry point exists.

expect.status: No partial Module is visible, both Modules remain failed without automatic retry, and only explicit reload starts another initialization attempt.
